requirement: REQ-ARC-FCP-5595 (the pruner) / CLAUDE.md Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline
inference_substrate_note: CARNOT_ARC_DISABLE_INDUCTION=1: the live E3AgentPolicy takes real actions against the offline arcade with NO LLM in the loop (no GGUF load, no CUDA). The pruner touches only the candidate-filter + frontier path, so the tier-3 generator is irrelevant to the lever and excluding it removes a large variance source. Same isolation exp5756 used.
verifier_is_oracle_note: No moat / verifier-value claim is made. The inert-click pruner is a candidate DROP-filter keyed on the agent's own observed frame-inertness, not an executable oracle, and this artifact reports a NEGATIVE on it.
solve_provenance_note: NO new solve is claimed. Every banked level appearing in these cells is a registry-known public-game level re-reached by the shipped agent as the A/B's control condition. The deliverable here is a lever measurement, not a solve. No public-game source was read; every number comes from the agent's own frames and its own counters.
random_seed_note: Three fixed seeds, MATCHED per cell between control and treatment (identical random.seed/np.random.seed and identical frontier_discipline_seed). Scoring is per-seed matched-pair; no any-seed union appears anywhere in this artifact.
reproducibility_checksum_note: sha256 over every measured cell row (both arms, all seeds).
duration_note: Sum of 150 real measured agent cells (budget 2000 each, both arms, 3 matched seeds) plus the 2-cell dead-channel probe. No LLM: pure offline-arcade agent stepping, 91868 graph states expanded in total.

control.name: E3_shipped_control
control.why_this_control: THE SHIPPED CONFIGURATION: frontier trio ON + HUD trio ON, i.e. arm G3's flag state, reached through the module defaults rather than through experiment_5836's arm kwargs. NOT arm A (that pins every lever off and is the PRE-flip agent) and NOT arm B2 (that pins edge_bar_hud_mask=False, so after the 2026-07-25 flip it is the HUD lever's treatment-absent condition, not the shipped config).

treatment.name: E3_shipped_plus_pruner
treatment.delta_vs_control: exactly and only what flipping SUBMITTED_INERT_CLICK_PRUNER_ENABLED does

arms.reproduction_sampling: ROUND-ROBIN BY ARM inside each (game, seed) cell -- never row order

acceptance_gate.gate: FLIP-CANDIDATE GATE (pre-registered before aggregating): the pruner is a flip candidate only if (axis1 capability PASS or UNINTERPRETABLE) AND axis2 efficiency PASS AND axis3 safety PASS. OUTCOME: axis1 UNINTERPRETABLE (anchor support zero), axis2 UNINTERPRETABLE (pass region empty a priori -- so the gate as pre-registered CANNOT be passed and is not a measurement), axis3 FAIL (2 lost cells). Not a flip candidate on any reading. The post-hoc states_expanded metric also FAILs at +12.0% pooled.
acceptance_gate.median_actions_to_first_levelup_delta_in: FORCED, not measured. Do not cite.
acceptance_gate.witness_pass_region_note: CORRECTED 2026-07-26. Previously True on a cell-level witness; the GATE-level witness shows the pass region was empty a priori (11 cells could move, 16 strictly-negative needed).

axis1_capability.anchor_selection_rule: control prunable_pathology_fraction >= 0.10 on some seed AND control banks 0 levels
axis1_capability.why: No arm wins ANY anchor game at this budget, so 'new wins on anchors' is arithmetically forced to 0 whatever the pruner does. Reporting 0 here as a measured null would be the forced-value defect that voided the HUD arm of the convention-transfer battery. Capability is NOT MEASURABLE on this corpus; the efficiency axis carries the verdict.

axis2_efficiency.PRE_REGISTERED_STATUS: THIS WAS THE PRE-REGISTERED PRIMARY EFFICIENCY METRIC AND IT IS UNINTERPRETABLE. See verdict.
axis2_efficiency.pass_condition: median matched delta < 0 (pruner reaches the first level-up in FEWER actions)
axis2_efficiency.why_uninterpretable: THE SAME FORCED-VALUE DEFECT THIS ARTIFACT CORRECTLY STAMPED ON AXIS 1, MISSED HERE. 20 of the 31 both-win cells are byte-identical no-ops (pruner_candidates_pruned == 0 AND trajectory_diverged == False), so their delta is structurally frozen at exactly 0 -- verified: the set of frozen-cell deltas is {0}. A median of 31 values goes strictly negative only if at least 16 of them are strictly negative, but at most 11 cells could be non-zero. The pass region was therefore EMPTY A PRIORI: median_delta = 0 was arithmetically forced no matter what the pruner did. The previously-reported 'FAIL' was not a measurement.

gate_level_witness.note: This is the witness the pre-registration actually required, computed at the GATE's level of aggregation. The previous witness was computed at the CELL level, which is how the defect slipped past.

axis2_efficiency.WITHDRAWN_witness_pass_region_non_empty: WITHDRAWN. The prior field asserted True on the strength of two lp85 cells going negative. That proves THE METRIC MOVES IN BOTH DIRECTIONS on real cells; it does NOT prove the MEDIAN's pass region is reachable, which is the obligation. Retained as the weaker claim it supports below.

witness_cells.caveat: NOT a favourable witness. This cell reaches the level-up in fewer ACTIONS while expanding 3.5x the STATES -- the exp5756 'reshapes rather than reduces search cost' pattern.
Same pattern: -291 actions bought with +1144 states expanded.

restricted_to_the_4_cells_that_moved_at_.note: 2 faster / 2 slower is the maximally uninformative outcome of a sign test. There is no power here.

axis2_efficiency.smallest_detectable_difference: With only 4 cells that move at all, NO efficiency effect of ANY size is detectable by a median statistic on this corpus. The correct pre-registered gate for a rerun is a per-cell PAIRED test restricted to acted cells, with a target n fixed in advance -- not a median over a denominator that is 65% structurally frozen.
axis2_efficiency.median_delta_interpretation: FORCED, not measured. Do not cite.

r11l_attribution_guard.note: r11l is the game the known-issues entry credits to this pruner. It must not headline.
r11l_attribution_guard.double_credit_warning: r11l is NOT the headline and CANNOT be credited to this pruner. On the shipped scored path the pruner OBSERVED ~1890 r11l click transitions per seed, tracked 81-94 signatures with 33-38 over its evidence floor, and pruned EXACTLY ZERO candidates on all three seeds -- the trajectory is identical to control down to actions and states_expanded. r11l renders a monotone step counter into the frame, so every action is raw-frame-CHANGED and the pruner's inertness predicate (computed on the RAW grid, arc_inert_click_pruner.py:217) can never accumulate specificity there. r11l's 0->1 level was delivered by the HUD/node-identity repair, and the known-issues claim that 'without it the pruner is what would have stopped 70% of the budget going to one wall-blocked click' is FALSIFIED by this measurement.

positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.why_this_matters: A null claim is not a finding unless the mechanism demonstrably had the opportunity to act (CLAUDE.md FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK). It did.
positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.conclusion: The pruner fired hard (146k+ candidate rows dropped), changed the trajectory on a large minority of cells, and moved actions-to-win in BOTH directions. The null is therefore a measured null on an active mechanism, not a degenerate no-op.

measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.claim: Adding a pruner arm to experiment_5836_frontier_discipline_ab.py -- the instructed path -- cannot measure this lever, for TWO independent structural reasons.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.reason_1_no_kwarg: CarnotAgentPolicy (what every exp5836 arm builds, via _harness's CarnotAgentPolicy(game, {}, force_explore=True, **arm_kwargs)) has NO inert_click_pruner parameter and does not forward one to StepwiseExplorer. Verified: TypeError: CarnotAgentPolicy.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'inert_click_pruner', and 0 occurrences of inert_click_pruner in its StepwiseExplorer construction. An ARM therefore cannot express the lever at all; the only in-harness route is flipping the global flag, which this task forbids.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.reason_2_dead_observe_channel: Even force-attaching the pruner to that explorer leaves it blind. The observe() hook at arc_competition_agent.py:2525 is guarded on o.get('previous_frame') is not None, and a node's 'frame' is only retained when one of NINE optional components is enabled (goal_bias / dense_curiosity / action_effect_expansion_prior / qd_generator / controllable_novelty_policy / object_centric_proposal_policy / go_explore_archive / similarity_retrieval / click_pixel_sampling). An exp5836 arm enables none of them. This is the SAME dead-channel class already found and fixed for the HUD collapse guard at arc_competition_agent.py:2374-2379 (which reroutes to self._last_unmasked_hash / self._last_grid) and never applied to the pruner 150 lines below.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.consequence: An exp5836 pruner arm would report a zero-error, byte-identical, states_expanded-equal null across every cell -- indistinguishable from a real lever null and entirely a harness artifact. That is measurement failure mode #5 (an uninstrumented arm reading as a legitimate null). The scored path E3AgentPolicy is the only harness on which the flag can do anything, so the A/B was run there.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.existing_test_cannot_catch_it: tests/python/test_arc_inert_click_pruner_live_wiring.py's ingest->observe test hand-constructs explorer.awaiting with a 'previous_frame' key, i.e. it injects the one field a real bare run never populates, so it passes against a dead channel. A regression test that runs a DEFAULT-constructed StepwiseExplorer and asserts pruner.observed > 0 would have caught this.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.STATUS_UPDATE_2026_07_26: REASON 2 IS NOW FIXED IN CODE, AND ITS ROOT CAUSE WAS BROADER THAN THIS BLOCK REPORTED. See live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review. Reason 1 (no kwarg on CarnotAgentPolicy) still stands, so an exp5836 arm still cannot express the lever as a kwarg -- but the observe channel itself is no longer dead on a bare explorer, so attribute-injecting the pruner into that harness now measures something.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.reason_2_dead_observe_channel_CORRECTED_: This block framed the dead channel as a PROPERTY OF THE exp5836 HARNESS. It was in fact a property of the PRUNER'S OWN WIRING: inert_click_pruner was absent from the nine-component frame-retention list, so its only learning channel depended on unrelated components. On the shipped scored path it was alive only INCIDENTALLY, via goal_bias=RelationalGoalEnergy and action_effect_expansion_prior=ActionEffectExpansionPrior; disabling goal_bias would have silently returned it to a permanent no-op. Fixed by falling back to grid_before (self._last_grid, maintained unconditionally), mirroring the HUD collapse guard's own channel repair.
measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.existing_test_cannot_catch_it_STATUS: FIXED: tests/python/test_arc_inert_click_pruner_live_wiring.py::test_scenario_arc_fcp_5595_observe_channel_survives_a_bare_explorer now builds awaiting the way _serve does (both grid and previous_frame resolved from the graph, hence None on a bare explorer) instead of hand-injecting previous_frame, and asserts observe still fires. Verified to FAIL against the pre-fix guard with 'observe channel is dead on a bare explorer' and to PASS after.

prior_failures.what_it_measured: offline m0r0 prototype at explore_budget 6; 32 click transitions, 0 confidently inert
11 games x budget 200 x 3 arms vs the PRE-flip baseline; states 931 -> 953
prior_failures.its_retire_condition: 'do NOT flip SUBMITTED_INERT_CLICK_PRUNER_ENABLED... Per the retire condition, another plain budget/roster A/B is not warranted without a NEW mechanism that makes pruning reduce rather than reshape search cost.' ops/verifier_gaps.md records the gap RESOLVED-NEGATIVE (2026-07-20).

prior_failures.must_not_be_cited: Its add:inert_click_pruner arm reads macro_delta 0.0 with effect_basis 'exact_trace_replay_no_counterfactual_environment_delta' and causal_claimed=false. A trajectory-CHANGING drop-filter necessarily reads 0.0 under exact trace replay, and all seven audited components read exactly 0.0. It is a NON-measurement and must not be cited as evidence about this or any other component.

doomed_rerun_disclosure: This run is, by the Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline, a scope-match to exp5756 with no operator_override on file (the exclusion manifest has NO entry for this lever -- all 57 entries checked). It was run anyway because the brief directed a measurement and because three things ARE different from exp5756: the control is the SHIPPED configuration rather than the pre-flip agent, the budget is 2000 rather than 200 on 25 rather than 11 games, and the harness is the SCORED E3AgentPolicy path rather than CarnotAgentPolicy. The verdict is nonetheless the SAME as exp5756's, plus a replicated safety regression exp5756 did not see. Per exp5756's own retire_if_same_verdict condition the correct disposition is RETIREMENT to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml, not a fourth keying -- operator's call.
recommendation: DO NOT FLIP SUBMITTED_INERT_CLICK_PRUNER_ENABLED. On the SHIPPED configuration (frontier trio ON + HUD trio ON = arm G3's flag state), over 75 matched pairs (25 games x 3 seeds, budget 2000, 0 errors), the pruner produced ZERO new wins on any seed and LOST ft09 on 2 of 3 seeds. Both pre-registered measurement axes are UNINTERPRETABLE -- axis1 because no arm wins any anchor game at this budget, axis2 because 20 of 31 both-win cells are structurally frozen so the median's pass region was empty a priori. The only interpretable efficiency read is a POST-HOC one, states_expanded, and it FAILS: +12.0% pooled, +37.9% in the non-HUD stratum. The strongest disconfirming evidence is the HUD stratification: the pruner is a near no-op (+0.4%) where the shipped HUD mask resolves, and expensive (+37.9%, 92% of all pruning) where it does not -- i.e. the cost lands precisely in the 'independent guard where no HUD is detected' scope that was the lever's whole rationale. Retire the lever in its current RAW-GRID-inertness form. A SEPARATE code defect found in this review IS worth fixing and has been (see live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review).
what_this_does_NOT_establish: It does not establish that inert-click pruning is a bad idea in general. It establishes that THIS implementation, keyed on RAW-grid inertness with a leveled>0 sacred rule, buys nothing on this corpus at this budget.
It does not measure the 8 lost games' capability headroom, because no arm wins them: the capability axis is UNINTERPRETABLE by anchor-support, not FAILED.
It does not measure the pruner under a MASK-AWARE inertness predicate. That is a different mechanism and would need its own A/B (and would satisfy exp5756's 'NEW mechanism' condition).

It says nothing about the nav-side HazardMovePruner, which is not wired into the scored agent at all -- 17 of 25 games' single most-repeated action is a nav move, not a click, so the larger repeated-action mass is outside this pruner's jurisdiction entirely.
It does not establish that the pruner is harmless where the HUD mask fails. It establishes the opposite: +37.9% states expanded in exactly that stratum.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal-prefixed so the conductor reconciler classifies it without re-running; the descriptive tail carries the negative so no reader mistakes a completed measurement for a win.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares that no LLM ran, so the duration floor applied is the arcade-agent floor rather than the 60s live-inference floor -- the ambiguity that false-flagged exp2837/exp5178.

per_seed_matched_win_sets.principle: Per-seed matched sets, never an any-seed union: a union inflates both arms and can show the control failing against itself (recorded measurement failure mode #3).

axis1_capability.principle: A gate whose anchor games are won by NO arm is arithmetically forced and is not a measurement; it is stamped UNINTERPRETABLE rather than reported as 0 (failure mode #2).

axis2_efficiency.principle: A gate whose pass region is EMPTY A PRIORI is not a measurement. The witness must be computed at the GATE's level of aggregation (can the MEDIAN move?), not the cell's (can A cell move?) -- computing it at the wrong level is exactly how the forced-value defect recurred on the axis this artifact called load-bearing.

instrumentation_witness.principle: Every cell must emit states_expanded, an error count, and a nonzero mechanism-activity counter; an uninstrumented arm reads as a legitimate null (failure mode #5).

r11l_attribution_guard.principle: The HUD lever already delivered r11l's 0->1. Crediting it to the pruner would be failure mode #7 (wrong mechanism) on top of a forced value; the guard records the direct measurement that the pruner prunes ZERO candidates there.

positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.principle: A null is only a finding if the mechanism could have acted; without this block the verdict would be indistinguishable from FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK.

measurement_path_defect_the_instructed_h.principle: A harness that cannot exercise the lever produces a clean-looking null; recording the defect prevents the next session from measuring the artifact instead of the mechanism.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content hash over every measured cell so a third party can detect corpus or shard drift between this artifact and any replication.

random_seed.principle: Determinism is the precondition for reproducibility; the matched-seed pairing is what makes the per-cell deltas attributable to the lever rather than to sampling.

duration_s.principle: Real compute takes wall-clock time; the summed per-cell durations are the load-bearing fabrication signal for this substrate.

live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.principle: A mechanism whose learning channel depends on an unrelated component produces a clean-looking null when that component is absent; recording the defect and its fix prevents the next session from measuring the wiring instead of the lever.

hud_stratification.principle: A lever's cost must be reported on the stratum its own rationale names, not only pooled; pooling hid a 3x-larger cost in exactly the scope the lever was proposed to serve.

dilution_disclosure.principle: An aggregate over a majority-inert denominator misrepresents its own support; disclosing the no-op count and the per-game concentration is what stops a future capstone citing a 3-game effect as corpus-wide.

repeated_action_jurisdiction_census.why: The pruner only covers CLICK labels (should_prune/rank_candidates leave nav+keyboard untouched by design). This census, measured on THIS run's own control cells, shows how much of the repeated-action mass is even inside its jurisdiction.
repeated_action_jurisdiction_census.note: 17 of 25 games' single most-repeated action is a nav/keyboard move and 6 games issue ZERO clicks in 2000 actions, including 5 of the 8 highest-pathology games. The nav-side HazardMovePruner, which implements the same trust+specificity discipline for moves and is consumed by OfflineSolver, is NOT wired into the scored E3AgentPolicy at all -- a strictly larger target than this click pruner's niche, and untested on the live path.

scratchpad_provenance.note: Raw per-cell shards + analysis scripts (dev-only, outside results/)

axis2b_efficiency_states_expanded.PRE_REGISTERED_STATUS: POST-HOC PROMOTION, DISCLOSED AS SUCH. This metric was NOT pre-registered as primary -- actions-to-first-levelup was, and it turned out to be arithmetically forced (axis2). states_expanded is promoted to primary efficiency metric here because (a) it is the lever's own stated purpose, (b) it is exp5756's own retire condition's metric, and (c) unlike actions-to-win it is defined on ALL 75 cells rather than only the 31 both-win ones. A post-hoc primary cannot carry the evidential weight of a pre-registered one; it is reported because the pre-registered metric carries NONE.
axis2b_efficiency_states_expanded.pass_condition: pooled states_expanded delta < 0 (pruner REDUCES search cost)
axis2b_efficiency_states_expanded.why_this_is_a_real_measurement_not_a_for: states_expanded moved on 26 of 75 cells across 10 of 25 games and moved in BOTH directions on the GAME unit (ft09 -378, s5i5 -16, eight games positive), so the pass region is demonstrably reachable. It fails because the pruner INFLATES search cost, not because it cannot move.
axis2b_efficiency_states_expanded.concentration_caveat: 93.2% of the +5180 is three games (lp85 +3109, sk48 +1141, sb26 +580). See dilution_disclosure.

hud_stratification.why: The artifact emitted hud_mask_resolved_control on every cell and never stratified by it, leaving its strongest DISCONFIRMING evidence unreported. The lever's proposed value (per the r11l diagnosis) is as an INDEPENDENT guard on games where no HUD is detected. Stratifying on exactly that variable shows the pruner is a near NO-OP where the HUD mask resolves and EXPENSIVE where it does not.
hud_stratification.headline: hud_resolved=True (19 games, 57 cells): states 30006 -> 30128 = +0.4%, 12,022 candidates pruned. hud_resolved=False (6 games, 18 cells): states 13338 -> 18396 = +37.9%, 135,738 pruned (91.9% of ALL pruning). The pooled +12.0% UNDERSTATES the non-HUD cost by ~3x.
hud_stratification.consequence_the_cost_lands_exactly_in_th: The stratum the lever was proposed to serve -- games where no HUD is detected -- is precisely the stratum where it costs +37.9% search. This is disconfirming evidence for the lever's stated rationale, not merely a null.
hud_stratification.efficiency_signal_lives_entirely_in_one_: Of 28 both-win cells in the HUD-resolved stratum, 1 moved. Of 3 both-win cells in the non-HUD stratum, all 3 moved -- and all 3 are lp85. Every actions-to-win effect this run observed is one game.

dilution_disclosure.why: Every corpus-wide aggregate in this artifact is computed over a denominator that is majority INERT. Without this block a reader (or a future capstone) citing '+12% search cost' or 'median delta 0' would be citing numbers whose real support is 3 games and 4 cells respectively.
dilution_disclosure.how_to_cite_search_cost: As a per-game distribution stratified by hud_mask_resolved, NOT as a single corpus percentage. See hud_stratification.

follow_on_if_pursued_at_all.note: SUPERSEDES the earlier recommendation of a mask-aware inertness predicate anchored on 'games the shipped auto_hud_mask unblocks'. That anchoring was backwards: the HUD-resolved stratum is where the pruner already does almost nothing (+0.4%, 8% of pruning). Any redesign must be anchored where the pruning mass and the cost actually are -- the NON-HUD stratum.
follow_on_if_pursued_at_all.BLOCKING_PREREQUISITE: 5 of the 6 non-HUD games (cn04, ls20, sb26, sc25, sk48) are won by NO arm on any seed at budget 2000 -- verified in per_game. Only lp85 wins. So in the stratum that matters, capability is arithmetically forced and both-win support is 3 cells, all one game. A HIGHER-BUDGET anchor run that gets at least one more non-HUD game into the both-win set is the prerequisite that would make axis1 interpretable AT ALL. Without it, a rerun repeats this run's forced-value defect.

live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.defect: The inert-click pruner's ONLY learning channel (the observe hook at arc_competition_agent.py:2525) was guarded on `o.get('previous_frame') is not None` alone. awaiting['previous_frame'] is graph[origin]['frame'], and awaiting['grid'] is _grid_for_hash(origin) which reads the SAME node['frame'] -- so the existing `or o.get('grid')` fallback rescued nothing. Node frames are retained only when one of nine unrelated optional components is attached; inert_click_pruner is not among them.
live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.severity: Same class as the defect this artifact documents. The pruner was alive on the shipped scored path only INCIDENTALLY (goal_bias=RelationalGoalEnergy, action_effect_expansion_prior=ActionEffectExpansionPrior both happen to be attached -- live-probed). Disabling goal_bias would have silently returned the lever to a permanent no-op, which is indistinguishable from a real lever null.
live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.fix: Widened the antecedent resolution to fall back to `grid_before` -- the raw grid of the previous _ingest, held in self._last_grid, which _ingest maintains UNCONDITIONALLY. Mirrors the HUD collapse guard's own channel repair (arc_competition_agent.py:2374-2379) rather than adding the pruner to the nine-component frame-retention list, which would have imposed a frame-retention memory cost for no benefit.
live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.why_this_does_NOT_invalidate_the_150_mea: The fix is a pure WIDENING: when previous_frame is present -- every transition of the shipped config, since goal_bias is always attached -- the antecedent passed to observe() is byte-identical to before. VERIFIED BY RE-MEASUREMENT: post-fix scored path on sc25/seed 20260724/budget 400 reproduces the pre-fix witness row EXACTLY (pruner_observed 70, candidates_pruned 1704, signatures_tracked 17, states_expanded 221, actions 392). The reproducibility_checksum is therefore still valid, as it covers measured cell rows that the fix does not change.

before_after_on_the_dead_path.construction: CarnotAgentPolicy(game, {}, force_explore=True) + pruner attribute-injected; retains_node_frames=False, graph_nodes_with_previous_frame=0

live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.regression_test_added: tests/python/test_arc_inert_click_pruner_live_wiring.py::test_scenario_arc_fcp_5595_observe_channel_survives_a_bare_explorer -- asserts the bare-explorer preconditions (node frame None, _grid_for_hash None) rather than assuming them, then asserts observe fires.
live_code_defect_fixed_in_this_review.does_this_change_the_flip_recommendation: NO. The measured A/B ran on the shipped config where the channel was already alive, so the negative result stands unchanged. The fix matters for FUTURE measurements and for any config that drops goal_bias.
